svg.title: VM data goes to Log Analytics and raises a heartbeat alert
svg.desc: The Azure Monitor Agent on the VM sends heartbeats, events and CPU data to the Log Analytics workspace log-azb-lab. The data collection rule dcr-azb-lab, linked to the VM, tells the agent what to collect. An alert rule queries the workspace every 5 minutes for a VM with no recent heartbeat and fires the action group ag-azb-email, which sends you an email.
svg.text: what to collect, where to send
